identity.mission: Transform a cramped, broken mobile experience into a serene, professional tool for psychologists.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix 'Clinical Precision' with 'Organic Warmth'.
Emotion First: The app should feel like a 'safe space' - calm, organized, and reliable.
Content is King: Data must be legible. No squinting at tables.
Zoom In: On mobile, focus on one task at a time (Card views > Giant tables).
Negative Space: Even on mobile, whitespace prevents cognitive overload.

usage.headings: Manrope, font-semibold or font-bold. Tight tracking.

mobile_navigation.menu_content: Settings, Admin, Profile, Logout (in a Drawer/Sheet)

desktop_navigation.type: Sidebar or Topbar (Keep existing if functional, but ensure responsive transition)

tables.instruction: Do NOT use horizontal scroll for primary data. Convert each table row into a 'Card' component on mobile (< md screens). Display key-value pairs vertically.

tabs.instruction: If tabs > 3, use a Select component on mobile. If <= 3, use a horizontal scrollable list with 'pill' styling.

forms.instruction: Labels above inputs. Full-width inputs. Minimum touch target 44px.

date_picker.instruction: Ensure all date displays and inputs use Australian format. On mobile, use a full-screen modal or native date picker if Shadcn Calendar is too cramped.

cards.classes: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 shadow-sm rounded-xl

buttons.classes: rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-medium transition-all active:scale-95

visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle noise texture to the background to reduce 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React (Rounded style). Use consistent stroke width.

images.description: Abstract blue and white layered shapes for a calm, professional header background.
Soft geometric shapes for empty states or success screens.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add Manrope and Public Sans via Google Fonts in index.html or CSS.
2. REFACTOR TABS: Locate the 'Weekly/Monthly/All' tabs. Wrap them in a responsive container that switches to a Select on mobile.
3. REFACTOR TABLES: Create a 'MobileDataCard' component. Use a media query to hide the Table and show the Cards on mobile.
4. FIX DATES: Global search for date formatting. Ensure 'dd/MM/yyyy' is used. Check the DatePicker component specifically.
5. IMPLEMENT BOTTOM NAV: Create a 'MobileNav' component that only appears on 'md:hidden'.
6. CLEAN CSS: Remove the aggressive '!important' overrides in App.css. Use Tailwind utility classes for responsiveness instead.
7. TEST ID: Add data-testid to all new interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use gradients for text unless it's a large hero title.
Ensure all touch targets are at least 44x44px on mobile.
Use 'gap-4' or 'gap-6' for layout spacing, even on mobile (don't cramp).
Always provide a 'Back' button on mobile sub-pages.
